name: Door God: General Qin Qiong (Qin Shubao) in Operatic Stage Costume on Horseback
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；early 20th century；Woodblock print; ink and color on paper; with printed shop inscription reading "Fu Xing" (probably the print shop name). Probably from Xi'an, Shaanxi; possible pair with 1935.37.90, which has a printed shop inscription reading "Ju Zao" (together their inscriptions read "Fu Xing Ju Zao", "Made by Fu Xing Ju"); compare with 1935.37.89 and .102.
